artworks.title: Iris and the Harpies (Attic red-figure pelike)
artworks.description: An Attic red-figure vase in the Louvre shows winged Iris, the rainbow messenger born to Thaumas and the Oceanid Electra, in the iconography that would define her for centuries — golden wings, caduceus, and the swift flight between sea and sky that her mother's marriage to the sea-god Thaumas made possible.
